title: Restoring an archived letter section after wish-erasure
desc: when handoff-wish-verdict reports WISH ERASED after an archive-to-sidecar move, the fastest correct fix is a full verbatim restore, not a partial patch
steps: Read the sidecar file you just wrote and paste its exact content back into HANDOFF.md at the same location, replacing the one-line pointer
Do not try to selectively keep only the answered wishes -- restore the WHOLE section verbatim, since the erasure check compares paragraph text, not summaries
Measured 2026-09-09 in WKAppBot: a full restore of the 11th letter section, done in one Edit call, cleared WISH ERASED immediately since every original paragraph reappeared byte-identical
